props.gloss_en: Rav Shimi bar Ashi was often before Rav Pappa and would raise many objections against him
one day he saw Rav Pappa fall on his face and heard him say: may the Merciful One save us from the shaming by Shimi
he took silence upon himself and raised no more objections against him
rain [falls] even for the sake of an individual -- which Reish Lakish too holds

Reish Lakish: from where [do we know] rain for an individual? As it is written: 'Ask of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain, the Lord makes clouds and gives them showers of rain, to a man grass in the field' (Zech 10:1)
(entertained) one might think [rain falls only] for all
the verse says 'to a man' -- [rain for an individual]
(entertained) if 'to a man', one might think [the rain is] for all his fields
the verse says 'field' -- [rain for a single field]
(entertained) if 'field', one might think [the rain is] for the whole field
the verse says 'grass' -- [rain for the grass alone]
Rav Daniel bar Ketina had a garden; every day he went and inspected it and said: this bed needs water and this bed does not
and rain would come and water wherever water was needed
[the stam: what is 'the Lord makes clouds'?] R' Yosei b'R' Chanina: it teaches that for every righteous man the Holy One makes a cloud of his own
[the stam: what are chazizim?] Rav Yehuda: flying [clouds]
R' Yochanan: a sign of rain -- flying [clouds]
[the stam: what are porchot?] Rav Pappa: a thin cloud under a thick cloud
Rav Yehuda: drizzle before rain -- rain is coming; and your mnemonic: a sieve
Rav Yehuda: [drizzle] after rain -- the rain is stopping; and your mnemonic: goat droppings
